mechanics_summary: 300–600-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ146, "Zen-Ohs' Earthly Excursion." The user charges energy in a protected stance and then fires a straight beam; holding the input spends up to 300 additional Ki to extend the attack and increase its damage. Current skill documentation describes a 19-hit beam. Exact charge timing, damage scaling, and frame data remain unresolved.
evidence_limits: Exact frames/timing/tracking, patch-independent damage values, and unresolved reward probabilities or gates are not promoted without direct support.
